tools.name: raid_counters
tools.description: Best counters for one raid boss, how many trainers it needs, its weaknesses and catch CP. `boss` is a Pokémon name or PoGoBud id (dialga, giratina-origin, mewtwo-mega-x, shadow-raikou).

tools.name: max_counters
tools.description: Best attackers, defenders and healers for one Dynamax or Gigantamax Max Battle boss, and how many trainers it needs.

tools.name: raids_now
tools.description: Raid bosses in Pokémon GO right now and in the next 31 days, with trainers needed and weaknesses.

tools.name: events_now
tools.description: Pokémon GO events happening now and coming up, with dates, raid bosses and bonuses.

tools.name: pokemon_info
tools.description: One Pokémon form: types, base stats, max CP, weaknesses, best raid movesets and the raid bosses it is best against.

tools.name: rocket_lineup
tools.description: Team GO Rocket line-ups (Giovanni, leaders, typed grunts) with the Pokémon in each slot and the best counters. Omit `key` for every line-up.
